**Finding submitted: RENEWAL — missing.**

- **Investigation:** § 10 (maintenance), § 11 (fees), § 17 (term/termination), the definitions, the general-matters provisions and full-text searches for "renew" / renewal mechanics. The only renewal language in the document is § 10's "renewable one-year term" (p0065); the licence is perpetual (p0117) and fees are left wholly to the Fee Schedule (p0084), with no amendment or uplift control.
- **Conclusion:** No usable renewal clause exists — nothing sets the renewal mechanic, a non-renewal notice window, or any cap on renewal-term fee increases, so neither fallback parameter is established. No walk-away feature is present; the defect is absence of terms.
- **Cure (preferred, one insert after p0065):** automatic successive twelve-month renewals, Sparkling opt-out on 30 days' written notice, Garman reminder 60 days before renewal, and maintenance fee increases capped at the lesser of CPI and 3%, with the 60-day/5% fallback offered in the comment.
